## Overview

Pico CSS, a minimalist CSS framework for semantic HTML, is no longer maintained. According to the project's [maintenance notice](https://picocss.com/docs/maintenance), v2.1.1 is the final release. The [GitHub repository](https://github.com/picocss/pico) shows it was archived by its owner on Oct 4, 2026 and is now read-only.

editor_notes.factual_accuracy: All checkable claims trace to the snapshots. (1) 'v2.1.1 is the final release' and 'repositories archived' are verbatim on both the notice and the GitHub pages. (2) Licence-vs-name point matches the project's wording and the article draws no legal conclusion beyond it; one soft spot: the notice says 'Please give your fork its own name', a request, while the article's last sentence says a fork 'would need separate branding', which is slightly firmer than the project's phrasing (clarification filed). (3) 16.9k stars / 505 forks match the GitHub snapshot but the article states them in the present tense without dating them (clarification filed). (4) Oct 4, 2026 comes from the GitHub archive banner, not the notice, and the article attributes it to the repository page correctly. (5) 'Reason given' and Analysis section correctly present the AI rationale as the project's own account, with no funding or licence dispute cited by the notice. No successor is named and none is invented.
